title: feat(lint): SDUI styling validator (ADR-0065) — the deterministic enforcement floor
body:
The enforcement layer for **ADR-0065**. The skill (#2221) *guides*; this *enforces*. `validateResponsiveStyles` is a pure `(stack) => Finding[]` rule in `@objectstack/lint`, wired into **`os validate` AND `os compile`** so hand-authored and **AI-generated** pages are held to the same bar (ADR-0019) — the floor that catches the deterministic mistakes an AI author makes, *before* render, with hints it can self-correct on.

## Rules

| rule | severity | catches |
|---|---|---|
| `style-node-missing-id` | **error** | a node with `responsiveStyles` but no `id` → CSS can't be scoped → silently dropped |
| `style-classname-tailwind` | warning | `className` with Tailwind utilities → never compiled from metadata, silently dead |
| `style-responsive-no-base` | warning | a smaller breakpoint with no `large` base → unstyled at desktop |
| `style-unknown-css-property` | warning | typo'd CSS property (`flexDirektion`) |
| `style-unknown-token` | warning | typo'd / unknown design token (`var(--spcae-6)`) |

Tuned for precision — the Tailwind detector does **not** trip on ordinary custom classes (`my-custom-scope`, the renderer's own `os-s-*` scope classes).

**Out of scope (by design):** whether the result *looks good*. Visual/semantic quality is only catchable by render + a VLM gate (ADR-0065 §Decision-5) — the cloud-side companion.

## Verification

- **Unit tests 9/9** (each rule + clean-page-passes + nested recursion + no-false-positive) — full `@objectstack/lint` suite **42 passed**.
- **Loop-verified on the real `app-showcase` styling-gallery page** (the one browser-verified to render): it is **lint-CLEAN (0 findings)**; a mutated variant (dropped id + Tailwind className + no-base + typo token) is **caught on all 4 defects**. The lint and the renderer agree on the same page.
- CLI wiring (`validate.ts` / `compile.ts`) typechecks clean.

This completes the ADR-0065 defense-in-depth: **skill (guidance) → lint (deterministic floor) → [VLM gate (semantic ceiling, cloud, next)]**.
